content.title: Stream Houston vs Idaho tonight in the NCAA tournament; how to watch March Madness live for free
content.text: If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation. By John Holland | The Oregonian/OregonLive The No. 15 Idaho Vandals meet the No. 2 Houston Cougars in this NCAA Tournament South Region first‑round contest. Houston enters as a No. 2 seed after a dominant Big 12 run, while Idaho was an automatic qualifier with its Big Sky Tournament victory. The tip is scheduled for Thursday, March 19, at 7:10 p.m. PT / 10:10 p.m. ET (8:10 p.m. MT) with a live broadcast on truTV and streaming live on demand . Watch truTV streaming live Is the Idaho vs. Houston NCAA Tournament game on TV tonight, or streaming only? What time does it start? When: Thursday, March 19, at 7:10 p.m. PT / 10:10 p.m. ET (8:10 p.m. MT) Where: Paycom Center, Oklahoma City, OK TV Channel : truTV How can I watch March Madness basketball games streaming for free? How to watch streaming live without cable : There are several options to watch this game and more NCAA Tournament games this season. If you don’t already have cable, you can watch NCAA Tournament games live for free with DIRECTV (free trial). If you are all out of free trials or just need a streaming service to watch games all the way through the NCAA Tournament, Sling is the cheapest way to watch every tournament game (costs just $23 for the first month). However, if your TV doesn’t already have one built in, you will have to buy an HDTV antenna to pair with your Sling subscription to get the games being broadcast on your local CBS station. If you already have cable, you can watch every NCAA Tournament game live through the March Madness Live app when you sign in with your cable provider login information.
